usedFor: An email address put into a new Asana task gets a Qualisend verdict.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Selected Project” in Asana, then “Verify Email” in Qualisend
bestTemplate.why: If each new contact gets a task, the address is checked as it comes in.

watchOut: “Verify Email List” needs a list or CSV, so a single task gives it little.
